999008199.text: ……ふう

どういうことですの！　なんなのです、
あのぷにの大群は！

localizations.en: What in the world was that?! What was that massive swarm of punis?!

999008199.text:
まだぷにだから勢いで誤魔化せはしたものの、
全く……肝を冷やしましたわ

localizations.en: At least they were just punis, so I could play it off with some quick thinking, but still... that gave me quite the scare.

999008199.text:
ごめんなさい、ララ様！
おっかしいなあ、ちゃんと安全確認したんだけどなあ

localizations.en: I'm so sorry, Queen Lara! That's really weird—I made sure to do a proper safety check.

999008199.text:
私も確認したのですが……
どこかに見落としがあったのでしょうか

localizations.en: I checked as well... Perhaps there was something we overlooked?

999008199.text:
あなたたちを責めてはいませんわ。
むしろ、見事な実況でした

localizations.en: I'm not blaming either of you. In fact, your commentary was quite excellent.

999008199.text:
しかし、あなたたちが見ていたというのなら……
まさか、何者かの仕業？

localizations.en: However, if you both checked thoroughly... could this perhaps be someone's doing?

999008199.text: そんなことを企む人、いるかなー？

localizations.en: Is there really someone who would pull a stunt like that?

999008199.text: いるとしたら……あの方ですね

localizations.en: If there is... it would be that person, wouldn't it?

999008199.text: ええ……
クリセルダですわ

くーっ！　ぷにの大群！？
そんなのありかよ……！

localizations.en: Damn! A swarm of punis?! How's that even fair...!

999008199.text: あら。そんなに悔しがってどうしたのかしら？

localizations.en: Oh my. Why are you so upset about it?

999008199.text:
どうしたもこうしたもあるか！
予想が外れちまったってだけだ

localizations.en: Why? It's 'cause my prediction was completely off!

999008199.text:
つかよ。お前も分かってるな。
やっぱこういうところには、コレが必要だよな

localizations.en: But hey, you get it too, right? For events like this, you really need some of THIS.

999008199.text:
すみません、列が長くて時間がかかっちゃいました！
ランツェさん、飲み物買ってきましたよ……

localizations.en: Sorry, the line was so long it took forever! I got you a drink, Lanze...

999008199.text: うお！？　お、おかえり！　天使ちゃん！

localizations.en: Whoa?! O-oh, welcome back! My little angel!

999008199.text:
そんなに慌ててどうしたんですか……？
あ、クリセルダさんも、こんにちは

localizations.en: Why are you so flustered...? Oh, hello there, Criselda.

999008199.text: ええ、こんにちは。まあ、彼には大人の事情があるのよ

localizations.en: Yes, hello. Well, he has his adult reasons.

999008199.text: そ、そうだな。ちょっと天使ちゃんには早いかもな！

localizations.en: Y-yeah, that's right. Might be a bit too early for you, little angel!

999008199.text:
うう、そうですね……フロッケはまだ未熟者です。
もっともっと精進しますね！

localizations.en: You're right... Flocke still has so much to learn. I'll work even harder to improve myself!

999008199.text:
……とても罪悪感を覚えたわ。
どうしてくれるのよ、ランツェ

localizations.en: ...Now I feel terribly guilty. What are you going to do about this, Lanze?

999008199.text: 俺のせいじゃないだろ！

まあ、とにかくだ。もし次があるなら
また声をかけてくれよな。楽しみにしてるぜ

localizations.en: Anyway, if there's a next time, make sure to let me know. I'll be looking forward to it.

999008199.text:
ええ。期待していて頂戴。
最高に感情を昂らせてあげるわ

localizations.en: Of course. Do keep your expectations high. I'll give you the most thrilling experience yet.

999008199.text: うーん……大人の話は難しいです

localizations.en: Hmm... adult conversations are so complicated.
